newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Albania running out of food, needs aid - Red Cross.
newsitem.headline: Albania running out of food, needs aid - Red Cross.

text.p: The International Committee of the Red Cross said on Tuesday that Albania was running out of food and medicine and urgently appealed for funds to finance emergency aid.

The Swiss-run ICRC called on donors to raise 15 million Swiss francs ($10.3 million) to avoid a major crisis in the Balkan country, which plunged into armed chaos following the collapse of a series of fraudulent get-rich-quick schemes.
"Albania is practically cut off from the outside world and is receiving no supplies of food or medicines," the ICRC said in a statement.
"The situation is all the more alarming because reserves are running out and considerable numbers of armed men are roaming freely around the country."

The ICRC said it would open an office in southern Albania, worst hit by the unrest so far, in addition to its operation in the capital Tirana. It said the funds would be used to finance emergency food supplies over a three-month period for 250,000 Albanians including 10,000 in hospitals and other institutions.
The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR said on Tuesday that more than 1,000 Albanians were fleeing their country every day for Italy and Greece, bringing the total to nearly 11,000.
